text: {"lessons":["My account is still above its Period 1 value, though it fell from its Period 7 peak; I should judge outcomes over time, not by one month.","These price moves have not shown a reliable way to predict the next move, so I should not trade merely because prices recently rose or fell.","Since losses affect me strongly and I trade infrequently, I should set a sensible risk plan and review it periodically rather than react impulsively or leave risks unchecked."]}
